title: Keep the first validated pending stateLock evidence when a recovered registration stays pending
outcome: When recovering a registration, a second valid durability-pending reply no longer replaces the first validated pending evidence. The terminal error and results.json keep the original stateLock diagnostics, while execution and credit eligibility stay unchanged.
acceptance: When POST 1 returns a validated pending reply with a stateLock block, and POST 2 is also pending but has no block or a different one, the terminal failure and results.json keep POST 1's validated stateLock block.
A test covers recovery from pending to pending, both with the second advisory block absent and with it different, and checks the preserved evidence.
